text:
Dana Li: opened PR to clean up the quotas + pricing examples and run a quick snippet audit. swaps legacy header and adds a short "how billing is charged" worked example. https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/pull/978
Omar Hussein: thanks — can you explicitly show which tier is debited first in the worked example? I suggest a one-line rule + a 2-row numeric mini-table.
Dana Li: yup. rule will be: reserved applies first, burst fills up to its cap, remainder billed pay-as-you-go. mini-table coming.
Vera Holt: heads up: grep found multiple uses of `X-Metering`. new SDK uses `X-RW-Metering-Context` and we recommend fluent `client.withQuota({tier: '...'})`.
Dana Li: doing a project-wide replace and updating code examples to the fluent style.
snippet-bot: snippet-lint: deprecated header finds -> examples/quotas.md: line 21, examples/snippets/ledger.md: line 9. Also: inconsistent inline/fenced formatting.
Omar Hussein: also check the Grafana panel JSON — the exported panel name is `quota.requests_by_tier` but the query in the doc uses `quota.requests_tier_sum`. Make them match or readers will copy wrong queries.
Dana Li: good catch. I'll re-export the panel JSON and embed the new file in static/panels/ and update the snippet.
Vera Holt: add a one-line migration note for Dedicated/on-prem: "Agents <= v3.1 continue to emit X-Metering; upgrade agents to v3.2+ to use X-RW-Metering-Context." Link the agent changelog.
Dana Li: added migration bullet and linked release notes under Migration -> Dedicated. kept it short.
snippet-bot: snippet-check: failing (no mock fixture). Please include an offline test that instantiates the v2 client and asserts header name and `.withQuota()` used. No network required.
Omar Hussein: I'll push a tiny fixture verifying header string and that the example uses `.withQuota(`. keeps CI happy.
Dana Li: thanks — once the fixture lands I'll re-run the linter and preview. Also adding a one-line parenthetical: "Embeddings billed per vector unit, not tokens" with a link to the embeddings billing page.
Omar Hussein: pushed fixture to branch, snippet-check passed. small nit: use single backticks for inline flags and fenced block for full snippets to satisfy docs-linter.
Dana Li: standardized formatting, updated preview link: https://deploy-preview-978--docs.redwood.ai/usage/quota-pricing-audit
docs-bot: PR 978 updated by dana — headers replaced, panel JSON aligned, fixture added. CI: all checks passed.
Vera Holt: LGTM. Dana, please ping #support and #eng-runtime so they can map old metric names and watch for dashboard alerts.
Dana Li: will do. merging after Netlify deploy; follow-ups: add sed one-liners to migration notes to help SREs replace metric names quickly. :rocket:
